level.description: Badge level whose criteria to select.
level.title: Level

criterion_ids.description: Criterion IDs within level, as listed by get_criteria. Omit to select every criterion of the level.
criterion_ids.title: Criterion Ids

category.description: Return only one category of the level, such as Security. The level index lists each level's categories. Cannot be combined with criterion_ids.
category.title: Category

detail.description: index returns each criterion's ID, category and requirement; full adds the official text, field names and justification rules. Defaults to full when criterion_ids is given, otherwise index.
detail.title: Detail

text_source_url.description: Source of the description and details text.
text_source_url.title: Text Source Url

na_allowed.description: Whether N/A is permitted, including when implied by required N/A justification.
na_allowed.title: Na Allowed

na_justification_required.description: Whether N/A requires justification; implies na_allowed.
na_justification_required.title: Na Justification Required

met_justification_required.description: Whether Met requires justification, including when a URL is required.
met_justification_required.title: Met Justification Required

met_url_required.description: Whether Met requires a URL in its justification; implies met_justification_required.
met_url_required.title: Met Url Required

detail.description: Form of the criteria rows; null without a level.
detail.title: Detail

levels.description: Every level when no level is selected, otherwise the selected level.
levels.title: Levels

query.description: A project ID, the project's exact repository or homepage URL, or search text.
query.title: Query

page.description: Result page, starting at 1. Use next_page from the last result.
page.title: Page

statuses.description: Return only criteria whose saved status is one of these. absent selects criteria with no saved status.
statuses.title: Statuses

include_justifications.description: Set false to return statuses without justification text.
include_justifications.title: Include Justifications

answers.description: Saved fields of the matching criteria, in draft format. A criterion with nothing saved has no fields here.
answers.title: Answers

criterion_ids.description: Criteria that matched the filters, including those with nothing saved.

level_criterion_count.description: Number of criteria in the selected level; null without a level.
